competitorWins: Recorded Future is genuinely stronger for technical cyber threat intelligence: 750,000+ sources, quantifiable 0–100 risk scores, deep coverage of dark web forums, IOCs, threat actors, and vulnerabilities, plus SOC-ready integrations (ServiceNow, SIEMs). Now a Mastercard subsidiary, it is built for enterprise security operations — a job WorldEye does not claim to replace. WorldEye complements it with a live visual picture of the physical world.
description: Recorded Future is a cloud-based Threat Intelligence Cloud (now part of Mastercard) that collects from 750,000+ technical, open-web, and dark-web sources, applying machine learning and NLP to produce quantifiable risk scores and analyst intelligence across SecOps, vulnerability management, and digital risk. It is sold in Core/Professional/Elite platform packages priced by organization size, with no published prices and no permanent free tier. It differs from WorldEye by being an enterprise cyber-intelligence suite — not a consumer live globe — while WorldEye is a free, no-signup live-planet platform with cameras, flights, ships, and weather, plus affordable Pro OSINT tools.

verdictCompetitor: Choose Recorded Future if your security team needs deep, quantifiable cyber threat intelligence with SOC integrations — and you have an enterprise budget.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want a free, no-signup live view of the physical world — cameras, flights, ships, weather, quakes — plus Pro OSINT tools from $3.99/week.
whyWorldEye: WorldEye's map is free with no signup; Recorded Future is an enterprise suite with no published prices.
One free globe combines 74,229 live cameras with live flights, ships, satellites, weather, earthquakes, and wildfires — a live visual layer Recorded Future doesn't offer.
Pro costs $3.99/week: AI analyst assistant, OSINT recon toolkit (Nmap, DNS, WHOIS, SSL), premium cyber/GDELT/maritime/conflict intel feeds, and high-res satellite imagery.
Free live aircraft and maritime tracking with global search and advanced filters.
Interactive 3D globe and mobile-friendly design for anyone — not just SOC analysts.
WorldEye does not replace specialized investigative tools: pair it with Recorded Future for a complete physical-plus-cyber picture.
